market_definition: The Brazil Reverse Osmosis Market covers reverse osmosis (RO) systems, equipment and components used to remove dissolved salts, impurities and contaminants from water through membrane-based filtration, for residential, industrial, commercial and municipal potable water production, process water, high-purity water, wastewater treatment and water reuse. System types: seawater RO (SWRO), brackish water RO (BWRO), industrial / process water RO, wastewater RO and residential RO. Components: RO membranes, pumps, pressure vessels, pretreatment systems, controls and monitoring systems, energy recovery systems and other RO components. Use cases: potable water, process water, boiler feedwater, high-purity water, wastewater treatment and polishing, water reuse and recycling, desalination, zero liquid discharge (ZLD) and concentrate management, for food and beverage, pharmaceutical and healthcare, chemical and petrochemical, power generation, oil and gas, mining and metals, pulp and paper, electronics and semiconductor, agribusiness and other industries.
